case: Sunday: "this week" asked on the week's last day is the coming week

parts.quote: What is on for the family this week?

answers.text: Practise reading is on Monday, 19 October, Parents' evening from 18:00–19:00 and Sign the school trip form are on Tuesday, 20 October, Football training from 17:00–18:00 is on Wednesday, 21 October, Swimming lesson from 16:30–17:30 and Piano lesson from 18:00–19:00 are on Thursday, 22 October, Dinner at Nona Marija's from 18:30–21:00 is on Friday, 23 October, and U13 match, Olimpija from 10:00–11:00 is on Saturday, 24 October. Pick up from the pool at 17:30 on Thursday, 22 October, and bring white shirt, shin pads & water for the U13 match on Saturday, 24 October.
